title: Agent chat P2: tool bridge — auto-generate AI SDK tools from agent-protocol Zod schemas -> dispatchAgentCommand
description:
DONE (P2 tool bridge). Generic AI SDK v6 tool set built from the agent-protocol command registry; no per-tool hand-coding.

Implementation:
- agent-protocol/src/index.ts: added COMMAND_SCHEMAS (AgentCommand -> Zod params schema, 'satisfies Record<AgentCommand, z.ZodType>' so it provably covers ALL_COMMANDS) + COMMAND_DESCRIPTIONS (one-line model-facing description per command). Added 2 previously-missing schemas: StageAddBitmapParamsSchema, TimelineSetSoundParamsSchema. Shared schemas: the 4 timeline frame ops use TimelineFrameParamsSchema; playback_play/stop use empty strict objects.
- authoring-ui/src/agentchat/tools.ts: buildAgentTools() iterates ALL_COMMANDS and emits tool({ description, inputSchema: COMMAND_SCHEMAS[name], execute: (args)=>dispatchAgentCommand(name,args) }). Returns the JSON result; catches all errors -> structured AgentToolError. Editor-ready guard: registry's requireCallbacks throws 'agent callbacks not wired'; caught and returned as {error:'editor not ready', editorNotReady:true}. dispatch is injectable for tests.
- authoring-ui/src/agentchat/systemPrompt.ts: AGENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT + buildAgentSystemPrompt(addendum). Describes Dash/Flash 8, document/timeline/library model, tool-driven workflow, read-before-write (doc_summary/editor_status), error handling.
- Exports from @flash/authoring-ui (agentchat/index.ts): buildAgentTools, AGENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT, buildAgentSystemPrompt + types.
- No commands excluded (all 68 mapped).

VERIFY:
- Build green: pnpm --filter './packages/**' build -> all 7 packages Done.
- authoring-ui tests: 727 passed (54 files), incl 13 new (tools 8 + systemPrompt 5). Tests prove: tool set count+names == ALL_COMMANDS; inputSchema is identical object to COMMAND_SCHEMAS[name]; execute calls dispatchAgentCommand with right name/args (registry vi.mock'd); editor-not-ready + generic errors returned not thrown.
- agent-protocol tests: 98 passed.
- core: only acceptable pre-existing failures = missing binary fixture fixtures/flash8-empty.fla (not checked into worktree; carchive-validate/contents-structure/empty-bytematch). Not caused by this change (core untouched).

P3 imports: import { buildAgentTools, AGENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT, buildAgentSystemPrompt } from '@flash/authoring-ui'.
